candidate_policy.meaning: precommitted balanced linearly implicit Ross step; sigma is numerical policy and does not change the requested hydraulics

physical_problem.hydraulics: unchanged qualified C1R N241 float32 bilinear log-mobility face law
physical_problem.internal_flux: recomputed from the accepted state at the start of every step
physical_problem.boundary_fluxes: prescribed q_top and q_bottom frozen from the initial state for the whole horizon
physical_problem.sources_and_sinks: frozen from the initial state for the whole horizon
physical_problem.reason_for_frozen_external_terms: all timestep resolutions integrate exactly the same semi-discrete physical forcing problem

precommitted_cases.finest_candidate_dt_lineage: same maximum dt already exercised conservatively in Gate D

independent_temporal_oracle.equations: continuous-time semi-discrete finite-volume theta ODE using the same C1R face flux values, MvG inverse and frozen external terms
independent_temporal_oracle.derivative_independence: reference ODE uses face flux values only and does not use the Ross candidate face Jacobian or linearly implicit step
independent_temporal_oracle.reference_self_check: coarse and fine reference final theta must agree before candidate errors are interpreted

transaction_and_piecewise_policy.each_step: start from the current accepted state, assemble one trial, solve once, validate, then commit locally to the qualification trajectory
transaction_and_piecewise_policy.rejected_or_unqualified_trial: must not mutate the prior accepted state
transaction_and_piecewise_policy.table_cell_transition: fails this smooth-regime F gate rather than averaging derivatives across a C1R node; adaptive retry is a later revision if required
transaction_and_piecewise_policy.exact_equal_head_branch: outside the unique smooth derivative claim and not intentionally exercised

explicit_nonclaims: This gate does not establish a universal production timestep or adaptive timestep controller.
This gate does not qualify saturation transitions, heterogeneous faces, groundwater or bottom-boundary switching.
This gate does not qualify Class-B H_ENPR or KSATEXM.
This gate does not compare RossFast to FullRichards; that remains Gate M.
A PASS is restricted to the precommitted smooth unsaturated horizon and sigma=0.5 policy.
failure_policy: Preserve failures and classify reference-oracle, temporal-accuracy, convergence-order, regime-transition, constitutive-domain or mass failure. Do not tune dt levels, sigma, reference tolerances or acceptance thresholds after execution; any revision requires a new precommit.
